# Marketing claims audit — 2026-11-07

Pinned revision: `ed15240ef891115d908e44317010ea0eca4d93f1`. Every location is relative to repository root at that revision. Code/release evidence is in `facts.md` (F1–F12); official dated vendor evidence and a comparison-data cell reconciliation are in `competitors.md`. These references resolve to concrete code paths/lines, merged PRs and exact official URLs. Short paths beginning `components/`, `routes/`, `content/`, `lib/` or `providers/` are relative to `apps/app/src/`; `messages/{en,ar}.json` means `packages/i18n/messages/{en,ar}.json`. No marketing/product source was edited. No runtime/browser/production checks were performed.

Counting: **41 distinct findings: A=19, B=6, C=11, D=5**. Repeated occurrences, EN/AR duplicates and multiple sentences expressing one issue do not inflate counts. Some A findings are unverified or overstated rather than proven false. The later ledgers also retain TRUE claims and nonfactual labels; those are not issue counts. One sentence can carry more than one verdict (e.g. shipped MCP capability understated and release version wrong).
